facts.claim: Independent seed 20260926 case 768: stationary target, no left stick, no detector noise, 108 center crossings beyond +/-3 px in 10 s, overshoot 31.905 px. This is measured simulation output, not measured game physics.
Changing only effect delay 20 to 9 ms or prior 650 to true plant response 918.611084 removes repeated crossings in the isolated X-negative case.

inferences.claim: Response and temporal alignment mismatch is sufficient to destabilize this synthetic closed loop. It need not involve game AA or a manual threshold crossing.

unknowns.question: Independent actual game camera response, effective delay, AA state and enemy motion remain unknown; this is not a live replay.

8 one-factor negative controls satisfy the same stability/acquisition oracles
12 LT-release counterfactuals retain exact +/-0.12 raw inputs
